task: One versus two L40S LoRA throughput on nlp-l40-1
user_selected_recipe: Earlier rank64 standard masked loss; no city uniqueness loss

stress.sample: 16 longest examples from the same 512-row training-only sample

measurement: CUDA synchronized complete forward/loss/backward/clip/AdamW/scheduler update; max elapsed across ranks; excludes loading, metric collectives and JSON writes
timing_order: Alternate 1GPU/2GPU screening. Reverse confirmation order on second repeat; second 1GPU repeat uses the other allocated card.

ddp.local_loss_normalization: mean over each equal-sized local batch; DDP averages gradients once

screen_selection_notes: Previous exhaustive L40S grid informs pruning but does not replace current paired baseline measurements.
mb4/no-checkpoint rechecked for feasibility; larger no-checkpoint trials omitted because a single replica keeps its own activations on each GPU.
mb4/quarter historically left under 1 GiB reserved headroom; mb4/half tests a safer larger microbatch.
mb8/all tests the largest per-GPU batch possible with 2GPU and global batch16; mb16/all covers the largest 1GPU batch.
No larger global-batch cohort: preserve training recipe for user-requested hardware scaling.
limitations: Different GPU counts/microbatches change RNG draws and padding; no claim of bitwise equivalent training between layouts.
Short profile checks speed and execution, not convergence or solution quality.
